= callout-prefix-subs(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc
:icons: font
:prefix: %

== Name
callout-prefix-subs - substitutions beside comment prefixes

== Synopsis

[source,ruby,line-comment=%,subs="+macros,+quotes,+attributes"]
----
S01 link:https://example.org/before[Before] % <1>
S02 *Bold* % <1>
S03 attribute {prefix} <1>
S04 pass:[%] <1>
S05 footnote:note[Note.] % <1>
S06 code ((Index)) % <1>
S07 anchor:target[]code % <1>
----
<1> Enabled substitutions and targets.

[source,ruby,line-comment=,subs="+macros,+quotes"]
----
S08 *Bold* // <1>
S09 link:https://example.org/empty[Empty] // <1>
----
<1> Empty setting preserves prefixes after formatted text.

[source,ruby,line-comment=%,subs="-callouts"]
----
S10 disabled % <1>
S11 disabled // <1>
S12 disabled % \<1>
----

[source,ruby,line-comment=%,subs="+macros,+quotes"]
----
S13 pass:c[%] <1>
S14 *percent %* <1>
----
<1> Protected and formatted prefixes retain ownership.

See <<target>>, footnote:note[], and <<_index>>.

[index]
